cases.script:
PATH=
case $(type -t uv) in builtin) echo builtin;; *) echo missing-builtin; exit 1;; esac
msg=$(uv --version 2>&1 >/dev/null); status=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"
case $msg in *'/usr/lib/bash-os/libexec/uv/uv'*) echo path-present;; *) echo path-absent;; esac
case $msg in *'install it with: pkg install uv'*) echo hint-present;; *) echo hint-absent;; esac
cases.oracle: The compiled-in uv contract specifies status 127 and the install hint when /usr/lib/bash-os/libexec/uv/uv is absent; type confirms the builtin is being tested.
cases.comparison: With an empty PATH and no compiled-in helper, assert builtin availability, status, helper path, and install hint.
